what_differs: On Sep 30 the team decided that referral bet-credit redeposits get their own streamlined queue/tab (no player selection), are not tracked as deal-level budget entries, and are allocated to the referrer inside the payout flow. WAGR-464 and WAGR-465 were last updated Sep 28 and do not contain these decisions; WAGR-464 still lists budget location as open.
suggested_action: Add the Sep 30 decisions to WAGR-465 (referral side) and WAGR-464 (redeposit side) and record the open follow-up L3373 (how allocations relate to the bet credit payout) on one of them.
